home.hero_line2: and practical advice tailored for your success
home.why_us_intro: Our industry leading expertise has been built on our core values to put our clients at the heart of all we do and provide innovative and practical solutions suited for our clients’ needs accurately, swiftly, efficiently and with accountability
home.mission_text: We help our clients succeed while holding ourselves to the highest ethical and professional standards. We work with diligence, accountability, honesty and integrity. We work as a team for the benefit of our clients and we do so with consideration and respect for the well being of all persons.
home.community_text: Our roots are at the heart of Mongolia, and we are devoted to its future. Dashnyam Partners, as individuals and as a firm, strongly believe in the value of community development. We encourage our people to use their legal knowledge and other professional skills to promote positive impact in our local community.

pro_bono.heading: PRO BONO AND OUR SOCIAL IMPACT
pro_bono.sub: We are proud of our commitment to community investment and the rule of law
paragraphs: Our pro bono work and social initiatives carries the same level of importance and urgency to our billable work. The aim of our pro bono work and social initiatives is to support access to justice and help people understand their rights and interests under the law.

Our commitment is shared amongst our whole team which includes the Managing Partner to our paralegals. Most recently, a team comprised of our Managing Partner, an associate and paralegal fought for a disabled child’s human right to access education. We did not stop there, we are now working towards releasing a series of publications on the steps parents or guardians may take in similar situations.
We want to make a real impact and where possible we collaborate with peers and other organizations to enhance our social impact.

form.category_label: Indicate category of service by checking appropriate box below:

notes: Pro bono work must be law-related and supervised by an attorney, judge, or law school faculty or instructor in order to qualify.
Pro Bono work abroad can also qualify as law-related and properly supervised. You will be asked to explain the nature and circumstances of the work in detail.
Pro bono work at a law firm can qualify as long as no fee is being paid, and the work is duly supervised and law related.
